/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import requests,time,re,json,os
query=''

def submit(db,taxid,query=query):
 params={'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastn','DATABASE':db,'QUERY':query,'ENTREZ_QUERY':f'txid{taxid}[Organism]','HITLIST_SIZE':'20','ALIGNMENTS':'5','DESCRIPTIONS':'20','FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2_S'}
 r=requests.post('https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi',data=params,timeout=60)
 m=re.search(r'QBlastInfoBegin\\s*RID = (\\S+)\\s*RTOE = (\\d+)',r.text)
 if not m:
  m=re.search(r'RID = (\\S+)',r.text)
 print(db,taxid,'status',r.status_code,'rid',m.group(1) if m else None,'rtoe',m.group(2) if m and m.lastindex>=2 else None)
 return (m.group(1) if m else None)

jobs=[('nt',34827),('refseq_genomes',34827),('wgs',34827)]
for db,tax in jobs:
 rid=submit(db,tax)
 if rid:
  open(f'rid_{db}_{tax}.txt','w').write(rid)
PY"
